unsupported.what: Structured tool calls and results for the 14,984 rows of the tool split (62.2% of 24,100) that encode every action as text: they load as plain messages, no call is parsed from the <function=...> blocks and nothing is paired
patch column as a trajectory outcome or output

runs_after_load.count_note: Same as the stage-0 value: all 24,100 rows of the tool split load, one run per row. Of these, 9,116 are native-format rows with structured tool_calls (277,520 calls, 269,242 results, all paired by id) and 14,984 are text-format rows that write every action as <function=...> text (loaded as plain messages, no call parsed, user turns stay user steps; 0 calls). Whether to keep the text rows is open for the plan owner; load(message_format='native') returns the 9,116 native rows only.

label_note: Only resolved is emitted as a label (run level, also the outcome). patch stays in dataset and is never read as an outcome or output; message_type is a structural tag that stays in the step source_fields and result_fields of native rows.
